title: .claudeignore
body: Please add a feature that will allow for a .claudeignore file in the root. Just like other .ignore files, this would prevent claude from considering any of the files in the .claudeignore. For instance, if I have some deprecated features, I don't want Claude scanning those and cluttering the context. The same goes for package files that Claude might not otherwise know to ignore.
author: wjatx
